title: Servitor of the Black Hand Gloves

sources.title: Servitor of the Black Hand Gloves

summary: Gloves add 1d4 Force to unarmed hits and cast Fear once per Long Rest.

fields.Fear: Once per Long Rest, use an Action to project a 30 ft cone. Concentration up to 2 turns. Hostiles make a Wisdom save or drop their weapon and become Fearful for 2 turns, fleeing and taking Disadvantage on attacks and ability checks. An affected creature outside the caster’s sight repeats the save at the end of its turn.
fields.Acquisition: Opulent chest on the top floor of Wyrm’s Rock Fortress.
fields.Base value: 240 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
